## Derived / confirmed formula

dot_dps = base_per_second(level) × stacked_instances × (1 + Σ increased) × Π(1 + additional) × (1 + Terra Charge factor as intrinsic-additional) × resist_only_mult.
stacked_instances = 2.0: "Deals N Persistent Cold damage every second for 2 s" — a fresh 2s DoT instance every 1s, applications STACK (owner-ruled 2026-08-10, Mind-Control-like ramp: lower damage in the first second, fully ramped at 2s) → steady state = duration ÷ cadence = 2 concurrent instances. L20 base 484/s per instance → 968/s steady state before pools.
